categories.main_business_segments: Hefei Jingsong Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in intelligent warehousing logistics systems and equipment, including intelligent warehousing, intelligent handling, intelligent distribution, intelligent factories, and system platforms. The company develops and manufactures intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and software, providing integrated solutions for various industries such as automotive, metallurgy, chemical, machinery, textile, electronics, power equipment, and new energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies including AGV (Automated Guided Vehicles), AMR (Autonomous Mobile Robots), 3D vision, SLAM navigation, multi-sensor fusion, digital twin, AI, IoT, and big data analytics. It develops proprietary control systems, navigation algorithms, and flexible docking technologies for robots. Production is order-based with customized design and manufacturing, integrating hardware and software to form intelligent logistics systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large enterprises and listed companies in industries such as automotive, chemical, metallurgy, machinery, textile, electronics, power equipment, and new energy. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on heavy manufacturing sectors and expanding into emerging industries like cold chain logistics and semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a nationwide presence through established business units in cities including Guangzhou, Chengdu, Shenyang, Hangzhou, Jinan, and Zhengzhou. It is actively expanding into international markets, participating in overseas exhibitions and optimizing its overseas marketing teams.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jingsong Intelligent operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and system solutions directly to end customers. It designs, manufactures, and implements customized intelligent logistics systems, acting as both a manufacturer and system integrator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent warehousing robotics, especially AGV and AMR technologies, digital twin platforms, multi-sensor fusion, and AI-driven optimization algorithms. It invests heavily in R&D to maintain technological leadership, focusing on industry-specific customized solutions and expanding into new application scenarios such as cold chain logistics and high-density dynamic warehousing. Future R&D projects include advanced path planning, multi-brand robot scheduling, and 3D SLAM for dynamic environments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and integrated system solutions, including hardware and software. The company follows an order-based production model with staged payments: advance payment, shipment payment, acceptance payment, and warranty retention. It also provides after-sales services and system upgrades, contributing to recurring revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jingsong Intelligent is a leading domestic provider of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and systems, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds a competitive position with advanced proprietary technologies and a broad product portfolio. The company competes with other domestic and international intelligent logistics solution providers, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities and multi-industry customization experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 836 million, a 25.75% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 42.9 million, a 1.48% increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.72 billion, growing 12.28%. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment (about 8.38% of revenue) and expanding market share domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jingsong Intelligent emphasizes high efficiency, customization, and integration of intelligent warehousing logistics solutions that significantly improve logistics throughput, reduce labor costs by up to 70%, and enhance storage density by up to 200%. Its proprietary technologies in AGV control systems, multi-sensor fusion, and digital twin platforms provide superior precision, safety, and adaptability in complex industrial environments. The company offers comprehensive lifecycle services, ensuring reliability and customer satisfaction.
